description: React component for displaying request and response logs with copy functionality, using react-json-view-lite and integrating with a notifications system.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard, using modern Clipboard API with fallback to execCommand.

methods.name: handleCopyRequest
methods.description: Handles copying of the raw request data to clipboard and triggers notification.

methods.name: handleCopyResponse
methods.description: Handles copying of the formatted response data to clipboard and triggers notification.
